Tijjani Reijnders.theme: Arrive late in the box: defenders watch the strikers and forget the midfielder

Tomás Paçó.title: Tomás Paçó’s calm pass
Tomás Paçó.theme: Stay calm on the ball and pass to the teammate who is free.

Toni Kroos.title: Kroos's free kick v Sweden
Toni Kroos.theme: Free kicks: when the angle is too tight, a short pass can open a better one; then curl it up and over into the far corner

Trent Alexander-Arnold.title: Trent's quick corner
Trent Alexander-Arnold.theme: Stay switched on at set pieces: scan, and when the other team is not ready, play it quickly

Trinity Rodman.title: Rodman's run past the full-back
Trinity Rodman.theme: Attacking the defender at speed and being brave enough to try a trick

Vander Carioca.title: Vander Carioca’s lay-off
Vander Carioca.theme: Back to goal, hold off the defender, and lay it back first time: let the ball do the work.

Victor Osimhen.title: Osimhen's leaping header
Victor Osimhen.theme: Jump off one foot to go higher, get above the ball and head it down toward goal

Viktor Gyökeres.title: Gyökeres's Power Run
Viktor Gyökeres.theme: Use your body to shield the ball from the defender as you drive toward goal

Vincent Kompany.title: Kompany's long-range title winner
Vincent Kompany.theme: If the defence backs off and nobody closes you down, set your feet and strike it clean

Vinícius Júnior.title: Vinícius's lightning burst
Vinícius Júnior.theme: Change your speed: jog, then burst — quick feet and a sudden sprint get you past defenders

Virgil van Dijk.title: Van Dijk's debut header
Virgil van Dijk.theme: Win the header: time your jump and meet the ball at its highest point

Vitinha.title: Vitinha: pass and move
Vitinha.theme: Pass and move: give it, then find a new space to get it back

Vivianne Miedema.title: Miedema's cool finish
Vivianne Miedema.theme: The cool finish: stay calm one-on-one, look at the keeper first, then pick your finish

Vozinha.title: Vozinha: set your feet, spring either way
Vozinha.theme: Signature move (a demonstration, not a match recreation): stay on your toes and set your feet before the shot, so you can spring either way

Wayne Rooney.title: Rooney's overhead kick
Wayne Rooney.theme: Timing and body shape: watch the ball, jump early, land on your hands and back

Wendie Renard.title: Renard's towering header
Wendie Renard.theme: The towering header from a corner: attack the ball at its highest point, then head it down towards goal

Wesley Sneijder.title: Sneijder’s header, 2010
Wesley Sneijder.theme: At corners, find the space and attack the ball: even a small player can score with his head.

Weston McKennie.title: McKennie's late header
Weston McKennie.theme: Attack the ball in the air: run at it, jump early, keep your eyes on it and hit it with your forehead

Wilde.title: Wilde’s power pivot turn
Wilde.theme: Be strong with your back to goal, then turn.

William Saliba.title: Saliba: the calm recovery tackle
William Saliba.theme: Use your speed to get goal-side, then take the ball calmly

Willian Dorn.title: Willian Dorn plays out
Willian Dorn.theme: A futsal keeper is a fifth outfield player: be ready to pass with your feet.

Willian Pacho.title: Pacho: the recovery sprint
Willian Pacho.theme: The recovery sprint: when the ball goes past you, turn and sprint back goal-side first, then win the ball (plus the 2025 Champions League final, where Pacho became the first Ecuadorian to win it)

Xavi Hernández.title: Xavi: the metronome pass
Xavi Hernández.theme: Keep the ball moving with short, simple passes, always look for space, and play the pass that controls the game

Yassine Bounou.title: Bono's shoot-out saves
Yassine Bounou.theme: Goalkeeping in a shoot-out: stay calm and read the kicker, take small steps to stay balanced, then push off strong and reach

Zicky Té.title: Zicky Té’s hold-up and turn
Zicky Té.theme: With your back to goal, hold off the defender, then spin and shoot.

Zico.title: Zico's curling free kick
Zico.theme: Free kicks: aim over the wall and let the curl bring the ball down into the top corner

Zinedine Zidane.title: Zidane's final volley
Zinedine Zidane.theme: Watch the dropping ball, stay balanced, strike through the middle.

Zlatan Ibrahimović.title: Zlatan's bicycle kick
Zlatan Ibrahimović.theme: If the keeper is off their line, look up: you can score from far out

Ángel Di María.title: Di María’s Maracanã chip
Ángel Di María.theme: When the keeper rushes out, lift the ball gently over them

İlkay Gündoğan.title: Gündoğan's 12-second volley
İlkay Gündoğan.theme: Be switched on from the first second: watch a falling ball, keep your head over it and volley it with your laces
